description: A Flask-based API server for downloading, searching, and serving audio content from YouTube videos, including rate limiting, file management, and partial content serving.

methods.name: nothing
methods.description: Default route returning a JSON message guiding to use /download or /audios/<filename>.

methods.name: compress_audio
methods.description: Compresses an audio file to MP3 format with 256k bitrate.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Downloads YouTube audio if duration <= 5 minutes, converts to MP3, and yields a JSON response with download info.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs a YouTube search with a query, filters videos under 5 minutes, and returns results.

methods.name: download_audio
methods.description: Endpoint to initiate audio download from a YouTube URL, streams the response.

methods.name: serve_audio
methods.description: Serves audio files with support for range requests for partial content.

methods.name: parse_range_header
methods.description: Parses the Range header to determine byte range for partial content.

methods.name: make_partial_response
methods.description: Creates a response with a byte range of the audio file.

methods.name: make_entire_response
methods.description: Creates a response with the entire audio file.

methods.name: delete_expired_files
methods.description: Deletes audio files older than the retention period.

methods.name: delete_files_task
methods.description: Schedules periodic cleanup of expired files.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Runs the Flask app on host 0.0.0.0.

methods.name: keep_alive
methods.description: Starts the server in a separate thread.
